verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Plaid Identity Verification as a personal (KYC) identity verification product—document checks, liveness, phone/address risk, watchlist/PEP screening via Monitor—with no mention of business registry lookups, UBO (ultimate beneficial owner) identification, or any KYB workflow that chains into KYC on owners. This is a distinct capability set from Plaid's consumer-focused IDV, and no citation addresses business verification at all.
